title: Bitcoin down ~10% on the week, ETH −17.8%, $1.25B leaves BTC ETFs | Weekly Recap
caption:
the week in crypto 🗓️ btc closed saturday near $57,900, down almost 10% on the week, after touching ~$55,600. eth fell 17.8% to ~$1,560. $2b+ liquidated in a day. btc etfs -$1.25b for the week (-$3.59b in november), blackrock's ibit posted a record -$541m day. eth etfs -$222m. strategy added 485 btc, now 850,849. next week: dell + hp tue, pce + gdp wed, us markets closed thu for thanksgiving. not financial advice.
